title: Production-Ready Modular Backend Architecture, Security, Real-Time & Offline Sync Implementation

databasesAndPersistence.primarySourceOfTruth: Neon PostgreSQL via Prisma Client v5.22.0
databasesAndPersistence.cachingAndQueues: Redis + BullMQ (Upstash TLS support & offline fallback)

securityAndIntegrity.googleGisSecurity: Server-side token verification with issuer & audience validation
securityAndIntegrity.rbacMatrix: Enforced at middleware & controller boundaries (SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, PASTOR, EVENT_MANAGER, FIELD_VOLUNTEER, MEMBER)
securityAndIntegrity.branchIsolation: Enforced across 3 Hyderabad campuses (Kukatpally, Banjara Hills, Secunderabad)
securityAndIntegrity.webhookSecurity: HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic verification & idempotency on Razorpay, httpSMS, and Google
securityAndIntegrity.logging: Structured JSON with correlation ID (X-Request-Id) and sensitive token masking

realtimeAndOffline.realtimeEngine: Socket.IO with Redis Adapter and granular room access (public, member, admin)
realtimeAndOffline.backgroundJobs: BullMQ workers for media optimization and notification retry
realtimeAndOffline.offlineSync: IndexedDB to server sync batch with optimistic locking and conflict resolution
